name: Moriya Ruri
source:
A quiet girl who is a member of the library committee.

She prefers reading alone to chatting with friends.
She is acquainted with Hibiki and Madoka, who are regulars at the library.

She believes she has no special talents and is passive in everything she does.
Because of this, she tends to envy people who have a strong sense of self.
